integrity: The stated group freeness follows from van Kampen and a complete two-skeleton attaching-map argument; modular calculations are corroborative, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires every vertex-deleted original graph to be connected; no full homotopy type or higher homology statement; originality limited by unavailable full text of a relevant enumeration paper and possible unindexed results.
title: Free fundamental groups of general-position complexes of leaf coronas over two-connected graphs
